scope: Declared scalar associated constants, committed concrete lookup and closed explicit-scalar CT equations; symbolic equations and wider constant consumers remain incomplete.

identity.algorithm: SHA-256 of repository-relative paths sorted by Python pathlib.Path component order, each UTF-8 path + NUL + exact file bytes + NUL
identity.production_selection: crates/**/src/**/*.rs; all files, not only changed files

binding: Copied both exact harnesses before target reuse and independently checked SHA256; recomputed all 325 production Rust files and both test sources directly from exact Git blobs using author Path-component ordering. Fixtures are include_str inputs in the bound harnesses.
source_review: Associated value atoms retain actual host, ordered trait arguments and member identity. Symbolic use obtains only the declared result type under available bounds; concrete value lookup requires a fully solved witness before reading an impl/default equation. Candidate values do not prove their own premises.

Unused and overridden trait defaults and impl values are checked, including missing/duplicate/mistyped members, unformed declared types, unsupported symbolic bodies and ordinary lexical value shadowing. Existing scoped substitutions hide associated namespaces when a runtime binding shadows their subject.

Closed explicit-scalar equations are evaluated by the existing verified source CT compiler and VM before ordinary Expand. The receiving scalar type and selected target width are retained; no new unverified evaluator was added to Expand. Private helper lookup uses the declaring module.

The WIP classifier accounting finding is corrected: group/type/literal inspection is iterative and depth-bounded, with payment before each traversal step and scalar name inspection. Dependency visitors, host and closed-value scans, namespace clone/retain and substituted bodies are charged through existing ledgers.
Raw shared-Span controls preserve trait/impl/item/member/function/value/type distinctions through static dispatch, Types/Analyze, raw and decoded-Wire Verify and actual native execution.
new_controls: Required/default constants, same Self with distinct Config<i32>/Config<bool> values, inherited constants and associated declared types; runtime namespace shadows preserve their own field lookup.

Actual local computed scalar fixture and declaring-module private-helper project execute Clang and LLVM API at O0/O2 without fallback. Raw repeated-Span associated fixture also executes all four profiles.

Closed equations include i64 arithmetic, full u64 values and grouped types/expressions. Selected 32-bit usize rejects MAX+1 while selected 64-bit accepts. Unused overflow, overridden divide-by-zero and foreign-call equations reject.
An invalid unused equation requested at Stage::Build rejects in CT with no native command, native_codegen result or executable publication.

Actual CT-materialized computed-constant candidate recovered from the existing trusted semantic cache is decoded and independently replayed through raw and byte verifier entry points. Recovery supplies no verifier proof authority.
budget_controls: All nine retained source request work/node boundaries independently replay N success, N-1 ResourceLimit, cold/warm/fresh identity and persisted-cache verification_runs=1. Const Expand 1381 and generic impl Expand 5905 also pass their exact controls. Limits were not raised; earlier source identities retain their historical values.
